import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    public static long computePower(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long p = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();

        if (k == 0) {
            System.out.println(computePower(p, p - 1));
            sc.close();
            return;
        }
        if (k == 1) {
            System.out.println(computePower(p, p));
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        long a = k;
        long order = 1;
        while (a != 1) {
            a = (a * k) % p;
            order++;
        }
        System.out.println(computePower(p, (p - 1) / order));
        sc.close();
    }
}
